archetype: Learning & Development specialist (English-language profile, German B1, no on-site)
summary: L&D specialist with nine years of experience designing onboarding and leadership programmes for 200 to 2,000 employees. I run needs analyses with business leaders, build blended learning in Articulate and the LMS, facilitate workshops and measure impact with simple evaluation models. I work remotely and communicate in English.

experiences.title: Training Coordinator
experiences.description: Scheduled and administered classroom trainings for a logistics company, managed the LMS catalogue and collected participant feedback.

experiences.title: Learning and Development Specialist
experiences.description: Designed an onboarding programme for 300 new hires per year, ran training needs analyses with team leads and built e-learning modules in Articulate Storyline.

experiences.title: Senior L&D Specialist
experiences.description: Designs the leadership development curriculum, facilitates workshops, trains internal facilitators, evaluates programmes with Kirkpatrick levels 1-3 and reports completion and impact data to HR leadership.

education.title: B.A. Educational Science
education.description: Completed degree with focus on adult education and organisational learning.
